reports.summary: The whole app is one screen: a field to add todos, the list with a toggle and a delete button per todo, and a footer with the count, the filters 'All', 'Active' and 'Completed' and 'Clear completed'.
dataSources: local state via useReducer in src/todo/reducer.js
current filter from the URL hash via useLocation
mobileIssues: a todo is added only by pressing Enter in 'New Todo Input'; there is no add button
editing a todo starts on double click; phones have no double click
'Delete todo' appears only on mouse hover over a todo
the checkbox of each todo has no name; only '❯ Toggle All Input' can be addressed by name
the credits footer links to the external site http://todomvc.com ('TodoMVC')
suggestedObligations: with no todos only the heading 'todos' and the field 'New Todo Input' are shown
typing 'Buy milk' in 'New Todo Input' and pressing Enter adds 'Buy milk' and shows '1 item left!'
with one todo, checking '❯ Toggle All Input' shows '0 items left!' and the button 'Clear completed'
after 'Buy milk' is completed and 'Walk the dog' added, 'Active' shows only 'Walk the dog' and 'Completed' only 'Buy milk'
'Clear completed' removes 'Buy milk' and keeps 'Walk the dog'
